preserved_prior_findings.verdict_rule: FAIL if d; else PASS if b&r&f&s; else UNRESOLVED.
preserved_prior_findings.canonical_order: B then R then F then S; D has fail precedence without ingestion truncation.
preserved_prior_findings.normal_form: Erase only q-invariant rows with exact-zero deferred effects; UNKNOWN is retained fail-closed.
preserved_prior_findings.certificate: Retained rows are exactly (ordinal,event_class,q_before,q_after,deferred_mask); validated certificates are equal iff these tuples match in retained ordinal order.
preserved_prior_findings.irreducibility: All five certificate fields have deletion counterexamples; ordinal needs two rows, every other field one.
preserved_prior_findings.guard_coverage: V0-V9 cover every declared guard; predecessor paired witnesses independently flip each rejecting guard in scope.
preserved_prior_findings.independence_conclusion: G_monotone and G_class are separable; G_chain is separable from monotonicity/class by a legal H_r transition whose q_before disagrees only with predecessor q_after.
preserved_prior_findings.conflict_precedence: Complete scan accumulates all defined rejecting defects; malformed rows suppress only undefined local predicates; defects anchor at earliest sufficient input position; first_rejection=min(anchor_position,guard_rank) with ranks schema<order<chain<monotone<class<nuisance; semantic scanning never short-circuits. C0-C4 cover undefined operands, same-anchor relational tie, same-anchor transition tie, anchor-over-rank, and reject-does-not-hide-fail.
preserved_prior_findings.outcome_algebra: Omega(P)=(diagnostic_axis,semantic_axis,accepted), with diagnostic VALID iff no rejecting defects else INVALID(first_rejection); semantic FAIL if fail_seen else UNKNOWN if unknown_seen else PASS if terminal q satisfies b&r&f&s else UNRESOLVED; accepted iff VALID+PASS. INVALID is orthogonal and never erases FAIL/UNKNOWN.
preserved_prior_findings.prefix_extension: Append-only extension preserves any existing first_rejection because new defects anchor after the prefix, and fail_seen/unknown_seen are OR-monotone.
preserved_prior_findings.incremental_summary: Canonical serializable summary S=(summary_version,rows_seen,defects,first_rejection,fail_seen,unknown_seen,tail,terminal_q); deterministic extend(S,row) is batch-equivalent for the V0-V9/C0-C4 verifier scope and keeps tail at the immediately preceding input row even when malformed.
preserved_prior_findings.crash_resume_contract: Persist one atomic generation containing stream_identity, canonical S, exact summary_identity, cursor(next_ordinal,last_consumed_ordinal), and exact last_row_identity. Load validates canonical summary bytes, cursor/rows_seen, first_rejection/defects, tail position/null rules, stream/domain identity, and envelope consistency. Normal next-row delivery extends once; one exact duplicate of the last row is a no-op; changed same-ordinal replay, gaps, older replay, mixed generation, or stream mismatch fail closed. Restoring fail_seen/unknown_seen/terminal_q/tail prevents false PASS or first_rejection drift. This proves verifier restart equivalence only, not exactly-once arbitrary external effects.

minimality_model.claim: Smallest guard-complete suite in vector-family count under one-fault-class isolation, with symmetric values of the same guard represented as parameters of one family.
minimality_model.why_this_scope: A concrete test case may instantiate each parameter separately; combining unrelated faults into one case would not distinguish which persistence invariant prevented drift.
minimality_model.lower_bound: Each family below has a distinct acceptance predicate or observable memory channel. Removing any family leaves at least one persistence-contract field/invariant without an isolated witness: normal forward progress, exact replay identity, conflicting replay, ordinal continuity, cursor redundancy, summary-byte integrity, domain/version separation, defect-cache consistency, predecessor-tail boundary state, empty-prefix null state, FAIL memory, UNKNOWN memory, terminal-q memory, or atomic-generation integrity.

canonical_outcome_notation.RESUME_REJECT(code): Fail-closed diagnostic before any semantic extend; extend_calls=0 and checkpoint semantic fields are not rewritten as evidence.
canonical_outcome_notation.NOOP_DUPLICATE: Exact last-row replay is acknowledged as already consumed; extend_calls=0, rows_seen_delta=0, then ordinal next_ordinal is required.
canonical_outcome_notation.OMEGA_EQUAL: All verifier-observable fields and final Omega equal uninterrupted scanning for the same logical stream.

vector_families.falsifier: Any extra/missing extend or any verifier-observable divergence.

bounded_leaf_result.sufficiency_argument: CR0 establishes the ordinary inductive resume step. CR1-CR3 make the replay frontier exact: exactly one identical last-row replay is harmless, while changed, older, or gapped delivery cannot be converted into semantic evidence. CR4-CR7 reject corrupted interpretation/state metadata before extend. CR8 preserves the only predecessor row needed by cross-boundary relational guards. CR9 fixes the zero-row base case. CR10-CR12 preserve all semantic memory channels that can otherwise turn historical FAIL/UNKNOWN/UNRESOLVED into PASS. CR13 excludes torn-generation combinations not ruled out by mere parsing. Therefore every state component used by the predecessor restart-equivalence proof has an isolated adversarial witness, and accepted restart executions reduce to the predecessor normal/duplicate induction cases.
bounded_leaf_result.minimality_caveat: The 14-family claim is relative to the declared one-fault-class isolation model and the existing verifier observables. It is not a claim that no smaller set of multi-fault concrete byte strings could trigger rejection; such combined strings would fail to distinguish which invariant is necessary.
